title: cyperus nyikanus
intro: Cyperus nyikanus, commonly known as the Nyika flatsedge, is a plant species in the sedge family (Cyperaceae) native to the Nyika Plateau in Malawi. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus nyikanus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
